# Ember

> A one-line-a-day journal web app. Each day, a person writes one good
> thing and one thing they're working through, picks a mood, and Ember
> tracks a daily streak. Entries can be turned into a shareable image
> ("day card"). All data is stored locally in the visitor's browser;
> there is no account system and no backend.

## Pages

- [Journal](https://ember-journal.app/): the main entry screen — write
  today's entry and see the current streak.
- [Streak](https://ember-journal.app/stats): current streak, longest
  streak, total days logged, and full entry history.
- [About](https://ember-journal.app/about): why the app exists and how
  the streak logic and share cards work.
- [Privacy](https://ember-journal.app/privacy): explains that journal
  content never leaves the visitor's browser.

## Notes for automated readers

- This is a client-side-only web app (React). Journal content is
  private per-browser and is not accessible to crawlers or scrapers.
- Source code: https://github.com/ArchishaT/ember
